interface.name: progressive-exploration
interface.purpose: Interactive runtime state exploration via the AI debug HTTP server (AIDebugServer in clientsmoke mod) in a running Minecraft client: probe screens, inspect game state, navigate UI, test hypotheses before writing code.

triggers.text: 需要知道游戏当前实际处于哪个 screen/state
调试运行时问题（实体不渲染、attachment 缺失、粒子不生成）
推理 MC/Forge UI 流程
检查 manager、entity capability 或粒子状态
写生产代码前验证假设

exclusions.text: 断点调试：jetbrain_xdebug_* MCP 工具已废弃，断点只能在 IDEA 中手动操作；需要运行时数据时用 /eval 替代

rules.predicate: 调试 HTTP 服务器（clientsmoke mod 内 io.github.tt432.clientsmoke.debug.AIDebugServer）仅在配置 ai_debug_port（JVM 系统属性，fallback 环境变量 AI_DEBUG_PORT）时开启；默认端口 25999，mcmcp_launch 自动注入
启动客户端前先 GET /ping 检查调试端口（默认 25999）：返回 ok 说明旧实例仍在运行，须先通过 /eval 执行 minecraft.stop() 关闭并等端口释放；connection refused 才可启动新客户端
从 shell 杀掉 java 进程
启动后必须等待 /loaded 返回 true 才能开始调试操作（资源加载阶段 minecraft.screen 与 minecraft.player 均为 null）
游戏启动后通过游戏内日志时间戳与进程启动时间匹配来确认 debug server 属于本次启动；/eval 结果异常（错误世界/屏幕/坐标）时怀疑 stale session
探测从宽泛查询开始，根据响应逐步收窄；/eval 代码在模板中运行，自动注入 minecraft/player/level（不在世界中时可能为 null）
预先写好整套脚本；必须由每个响应决定下一个查询
确认行为后写单元测试或更新文档，不让发现停留在临时状态
退回“猜 → 改代码 → 重建 → 重启”循环而跳过运行时验证；/eval 探测等价于一次可编程断点检视，能证明代码路径到达并给出真实数据
写 eval 前用 glob/grep 核实类路径，不要猜包名；模板仅自动导入 Minecraft、LocalPlayer、ClientLevel，其余类必须用全限定名
AIDebugServer 用 JDK 内置编译器（非 Janino），支持完整 Java 语法：var、lambda、Map.of()、records、switch 表达式、多行 if/return 块
代码在 MC 渲染线程执行且有 10 秒超时；世界生成等重操作会使 HTTP 响应超时但可能仍异步完成
所有 MC API 调用经 Minecraft.tell() 在渲染线程执行；长时间运行的代码会阻塞渲染循环

workflow.action: 启动前 GET /ping：ok → 先 /eval minecraft.stop() 关旧实例并等端口释放；refused → 启动新客户端
轮询 GET /loaded（间隔 3 秒）直到返回 true，再开始调试
用 /eval 宽泛探测当前状态（屏幕、UI 元素、管理器、实体状态），根据每次响应收窄并决定下一个查询，循环直至假设被证实或证伪
确认行为后写单元测试或更新文档固化发现

tools.name: GET /ping
observations: connection refused → 端口空闲可启动

tools.name: GET /loaded
observations: {"loaded": true} → 游戏就绪（标题画面或世界中）
{"loaded": false} → 仍在加载资源，继续等待

tools.name: /eval (mcmcp_execute)
required_args: code（Java 方法体，模板自动注入 minecraft/player/level；仅自动导入 Minecraft/LocalPlayer/ClientLevel）
preconditions: 客户端以 ai_debug_port 启动（默认 25999）
observations: return 表达式的值作为响应返回
errors: 10 秒渲染线程超时（HTTP 超时但代码可能异步完成）

sourceBlocks.B0636bcf0b1a5d0ca: You need to know what screen/state the game is actually in
sourceBlocks.Bc4342abd7a465ba3: You're debugging a runtime issue (entity not rendering, attachment missing, particle not spawning)
sourceBlocks.B296260a64590ec1c: You're reasoning about MC/Forge UI flow
sourceBlocks.B28d99ede361bafe0: You want to inspect managers, entity capabilities, or particle states
sourceBlocks.B5e0989f58758fe3f: You need to verify a hypothesis before writing production code
sourceBlocks.B6fa032bc27c786d2: 调试 HTTP 服务器是 clientsmoke mod 内的 AIDebugServer（`io.github.tt432.clientsmoke.debug`），仅在配置 `ai_debug_port`（JVM 系统属性，fallback 环境变量 `AI_DEBUG_PORT`）时开启。默认端口 `25999`（`mcmcp_launch` 会自动注入）。
sourceBlocks.B0498e3c6e22f25f8: Before starting the client, always check the debug port (default 25999):
sourceBlocks.B0dc84702ab47f1b8:
GET /ping → {"status": "ok"}  → old instance still running → minecraft.stop() first
GET /ping → connection refused → port free, safe to start
sourceBlocks.B3778aa9e62b383e8: If an old instance is running, close it via `/eval`:
sourceBlocks.Bbe41e757fcb76cf9: Wait for port to be freed before launching the new client. **Never kill java processes from shell.**
sourceBlocks.B899fcbccd465f5be: 客户端启动后需要经历资源加载阶段，此阶段 `minecraft.screen` 和 `minecraft.player` 均为 null。**启动后必须等待 `/loaded` 返回 `true` 才能开始调试操作。**
sourceBlocks.Bacb74c88f7b0ee72:
GET /loaded → {"loaded": true}  → 游戏已就绪（标题画面或世界中）
GET /loaded → {"loaded": false} → 仍在加载资源，继续等待
sourceBlocks.B612f714f08cea9a1: 等待示例（轮询间隔 3 秒）：
sourceBlocks.Bbda0918b91d2dac1: After game startup, confirm the debug server belongs to the current launch by checking the in-game log timestamp matches the process start time. If `/eval` gives unexpected results (wrong world, wrong screen, different position), suspect a stale session.
sourceBlocks.Bd77150606a696e6e: Start broad, narrow down based on the response. The code runs inside a template that auto-injects `minecraft`, `player`, `level`. They may be null if not in a world.
sourceBlocks.B64d5d8e551ca000f: Each response guides the next query. Don't write a script upfront — let the runtime state decide.
sourceBlocks.Bfc07fae5d789296b: Once you confirm the behavior, write a unit test or update documentation. Don't leave findings ephemeral.
sourceBlocks.Be15a78df357d9d69:
// Close the game properly — never kill java processes from shell
minecraft.stop();
sourceBlocks.B763541ade62c36d7: > **`jetbrain_xdebug_*` MCP 工具已废弃**，当前 session 无断点调试 MCP 能力。断点调试只能在 IDEA 中手动操作（agent 无法直接设断点）。需要运行时数据时，用 progressive exploration 的 `/eval`（`mcmcp_execute`）作为替代。
sourceBlocks.B4190995f9b8e947d: `/eval` 一次就能拿到真实的运行时数据：在可疑代码路径上调用方法、读字段、打印状态，验证假设后再改代码。不要退回"猜 → 改代码 → 重建 → 重启"的循环——`/eval` 等价于一次可编程的断点检视。
sourceBlocks.Bba64cb8cf7d85a52: Never skip runtime verification in favor of "guess → change code → rebuild → restart". An `/eval` probe proves the code path is reached and shows real data.
sourceBlocks.Bbc1c3d31b6a6087b: The `/eval` template auto-injects `Minecraft`, `LocalPlayer`, `ClientLevel` via the JDK's built-in compiler (not Janino). All other classes need fully qualified names. **Before writing an eval, verify the class path** — don't guess package names. Use `glob`/`grep` 查找类路径。
sourceBlocks.Bd81602ef76320bc5: **Compiler**: AIDebugServer uses the JDK's built-in compiler (not Janino). Full Java syntax is supported: `var`, lambda, `Map.of()`, records, switch expressions, multi-line `if/return` blocks.
sourceBlocks.B706a2d23e7c264cd: **Auto-imports**: only `Minecraft`, `LocalPlayer`, `ClientLevel` are imported. Other classes need fully qualified names.
sourceBlocks.B71f8692abca23b64: **Timeout**: code runs on the MC render thread with a 10-second timeout. World generation and heavy operations will time out the HTTP response but may still complete asynchronously.
sourceBlocks.B5cc623c349b9a1d1: **Thread safety**: all MC API calls execute on the render thread via `Minecraft.tell()`. Long-running code blocks the render loop.
